theme_and_identity.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST mixed with LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Mystery)
theme_and_identity.primary_directive: Create a rich, dark-mode real estate experience that feels like an exclusive members club, directly contrasting with the bright, generic 'Zillow' aesthetic. Emphasize trust through stark contrasts, gold accents, and transparent escrow mechanics.

headings.style: Swiss Brutalist (Radical weight contrast, e.g., Light vs Black)

rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato for Headings.
Headings (Size > 32px) MUST use tight letter spacing.
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always tint neutral greys.
Hover state color must be a lighter hue of ACTIVE state color.
Use Signal Red sparingly for anti-corporate warnings, blacklists, or critical escrow alerts.

surface_strategies.headers: GLASSMORPHISM (The 'Crystal' Variant) with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-[#121217]/70. 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10).
surface_strategies.escrow_cards: THE 'TRACING BEAM' - a glowing border effect for high-conversion contracts and escrow commitments.
surface_strategies.dashboard_widgets: NEUMORPHISM (The 'Tactile' Variant) - mix soft shadows with sharp inner contrasts, sharp 1px border to ground it.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on hero sections to kill digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_pages: MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' GRID. Asymmetry, Visual Tension, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_pages: MODE B: High Density Grid. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized with flat solid surfaces.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale: p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24). Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
rules: Grid items must be direct children. Override default stretch with align-items: start.

component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. If primary, use Gold with black text. Hover state must be lighter hue with subtle lift.
component_rules.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-lg and -translate-y-1.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn components heavily customized. Dark inputs with 1px border. Focus state: border-gold ring-1 ring-gold.
component_rules.navigation: Always visible navigation links on desktop. Sticky header with glassmorphism.
component_rules.tables_and_lists: Use Shadcn UI components for data-heavy dashboard views. Grid borders to expose the skeleton.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Entrance animations staggered for lead lists. Smooth transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon' showing 'Zero Risk • Local Experts • 6% Escrow Secured' in pale background with dark earthy text.
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Focus states must have higher contrast.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use text shadow over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="lead-submit-button"`).

hero_background.description: Abstract low angle modern architecture for hero background. Use with heavy bg-black/50 overlay.

luxury_house.description: Backyard view of a modern luxurious cottage, to be used in the buyer/seller section to represent high-quality leads.

agent_portrait_1.description: Professional male agent in suit for 'Local Independent Experts' section.

agent_portrait_2.description: Professional female agent in blazer for 'Local Independent Experts' section.

contract_signing.description: Close up of signing contract for the 'Escrow Security and Binding Agreements' section.

rules: Mobile Height Limit: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile devices.
Max overlay opacity: bg-black/50. If the image isn't visible through the overlay, you're wasting it.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Do not center-align the main app container. Use left-alignment for body and dense content.
Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) for sticky headers. Never use fully transparent headers over content.
Ensure dark mode is the default and only theme.
Do not use default generic HTML inputs; use Shadcn UI components for forms (Input, Select, Form).
For the Escrow/Contract signature step, build a clean, high-contrast digital signature UI with a clear 'Typed Signature' input field.
Never use Zillow brand colors (Blue/Green combos) – stick strictly to the Midnight Blue/Gold/Signal Red palette to reinforce the anti-corporate stance.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters. DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). DO NOT center align the app container. Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp). NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
